name: mastande-za
description: Mastande ZA — South Africa's room-letting notice board. Monorepo root (git hooks + workspace scripts only; app code lives in frontend/ and backend/).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.audit: npm run audit:routes && npm run audit:i18n && npm run audit:env
scripts.lighthouse: npm --prefix frontend run build:prod && npx @lhci/cli@0.14.x autorun --config=lighthouserc.json
scripts.e2e: playwright install chromium --with-deps >/dev/null 2>&1 || playwright install chromium; playwright test
scripts.migrate:staging: cd backend && DATABASE_URL="$NEON_POOLED" DIRECT_URL="$NEON_DIRECT" npx prisma migrate deploy
